Jharkhand Passport Adalat : rajdhani ranchi men pasport se juri samasyaon ke samadhan ke lie 30 aktubar ko pasport adalat ka aayojan kiya jaega. kshetriy pasport karyalay ki or se aayojit is adalat men lanbit pasport aavednon ke tvarit nishpadan par vishesh jor rahega. pasport adalat subah 10 baje se dophar 2 baje tak ratu rod sthit gaileksiya mol ke tisre tal par aayojit hogi. is sanbandh men kshetriy pasport adhikari manita ke. ne zi midiya se vishesh batchit ki.
